verdict.rationale: Finix documents webhooks that deliver programmatic notifications when API resources are created or updated. Webhooks can be created and updated, including through the Dashboard, and a Webhook Logs feature shows deliveries from the past 30 days. Missing for 10: documented per-event-type subscription filtering and delivery/retry/signature details in the evidence, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks let you receive notifications programmatically when your API resources are created or updated.
Finix also supports creating and updating webhooks through the Finix Dashboard.
Finix's Webhook Logs allow you to view the webhooks sent by Finix in the past 30 days.
